summary: Tweens a hologram shader's alpha for a materialise or dematerialise transition.
overview: Drop it alongside a Renderer using the hologram shader. SetVisible tweens the alpha through the tween engine so the object fades in or out rather than snapping.
useCases: A projected hologram appearing and disappearing.
A sci-fi UI element materialising in world space.
A ghostly or phased-out enemy state.

gotchas.title: It fades the shader, not the object
gotchas.body: The renderer stays enabled at zero alpha. Disable it yourself if invisible should also mean free.
